```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results='asis', 
  echo = FALSE
)

library(glue)
library(tidyverse)

# Set this to true to have links turned into footnotes at the end of the document
PDF_EXPORT <- FALSE

# Holds all the links that were inserted for placement at the end
links <- c()

source('parsing_functions.R')

# Load csv with position info
position_data <- read_csv('positions.csv')
```

intro_text <- "Creative Consultant with over a decade of experience in orchestrating awe-inspiring spectacles, leveraging advanced illusionary techniques, and advising high-profile leadership.
